stem.en: During training, the model gets a noisy picture of a horse. What is it asked to guess, so that taking the guess away leaves something closer to the horse?

text.en: How noisy the picture looks, as one score
The clean picture, pixel by pixel
Which saved photo the picture came from

explanation.en: The model estimates the added random numbers. Taking that noise guess away from the noisy numbers leaves something closer to the picture.
